publication_review.task: Locate where a plugin is missing and distinguish a rejected path from a server startup issue or an absent client feature.
publication_review.answer_gap: The official guide documents directory layout and client scopes. The sampled directory and curated repository mainly help discovery. None of these sampled answers show the controlled V2 comparison of package list output versus setup execution for both directory and file cases.
publication_review.unique_value: Three controlled V2.4.1 cases and a user reproducible marker. Two directory paths trigger actual server setup with debug agents; the single-file config does not. Package listing alone showed no plugins for all three fixtures.
